Resolve the following error that appears when I launch Pi.

❯ pi
 Extension "/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/index.ts" error: Builtin override 'reviewer' in '/Users/mm/.pi/agent/settings.json' uses
 removed field 'fallbackModels'; configure one model instead.
   at parseBuiltinOverrideEntry (/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/agents/agents.ts:999:11)
   at readSubagentSettings (/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/agents/agents.ts:1259:24)
   at ensureSettingsForScope (/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/agents/agents.ts:2693:52)
   at settingsForScope (/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/agents/agents.ts:2705:3)
   at configuredAgentsForScope (/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/agents/agents.ts:2722:60)
   at buildEffectiveDiscovery (/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/agents/agents.ts:2789:22)
   at discoverAgents (/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/agents/agents.ts:2912:10)
   at refreshAdvertisedAgents (/Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/extension/index.ts:539:51)
   at /Users/mm/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-subagents/src/extension/index.ts:1203:5
   at ExtensionRunner.emit
 (file:///opt/homebrew/Cellar/pi-coding-agent/0.85.1/libexec/lib/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/bundle/chunks/chunk-JVUZSMYM.js:1066:2992
 1)
I'll look at the settings file to see the offending override.
Removing the removed `fallbackModels` field from both overrides.
Let me verify the file is still valid JSON.

Fixed. `fallbackModels` was removed from the subagents settings schema, so I deleted it from both the `reviewer` and `oracle` overrides in `/Users/mm/.pi/agent/settings.json`. Each now configures a single `model` (`openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol`) with `thinking: high`, and the file validates as JSON.

The error should be gone on next `pi` launch. Note the fallback targets (`claude-sdk/claude-5-sonnet`, `claude-sdk/claude-5-opus`) are no longer configured — if a primary model is unavailable, those agents will just fail rather than fall back.
